instructions.name: cancel_campaign
docs: Cancel campaign (only by creator, before end time)

instructions.name: cancel_pledge
docs: Cancel a pledge and get refund (only if campaign failed)

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim funds if campaign reached its goal

instructions.name: create_milestone
docs: Register a milestone for a campaign. Milestones define staged fund release.

instructions.name: extend_campaign
docs: Extend campaign end time (only by creator, before current end time)

instructions.name: fail_campaign_and_open_refunds
docs: Fail a milestone campaign after a rejected review and open proportional refunds for backers.

instructions.name: finalize_campaign
docs: Finalize campaign after deadline and fix its terminal state on-chain

instructions.name: finalize_milestone
docs: Finalize milestone voting once quorum or timeout conditions are met.

instructions.name: open_dispute
docs: Open a formal dispute for a rejected milestone so the arbiter can make the final decision.

instructions.name: release_milestone_funds
docs: Release milestone funds after approval. Gross milestone amount is split into creator payout and treasury fee.

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: Resolve a disputed milestone via arbiter decision.

instructions.name: settle_campaign
docs: - successful campaigns are automatically funded to creator/treasury
- failed campaigns are finalized into Failed state and open refunds

instructions.name: submit_milestone
docs: Submit a milestone for backer review after fundraising succeeds.

instructions.name: vote_milestone
docs: Cast a weighted vote for a submitted milestone.
